# Chestha

> Local-first personal workspace in the browser. Tasks, a calendar, a focus garden (Grove), DSA practice, ambient sound, and an optional Chrome New Tab. No account. Data stays on this device in IndexedDB.

Chestha is a Vite + React SPA. Primary navigation uses hash routes (`#/…`). The same build ships as the website and as a Chrome extension New Tab page (separate origins — export/import to move data).

## Public site

- [Home](https://chestha.vercel.app/): Marketing landing — product overview, Add to Chrome, Buy me a coffee.
- [Guide](https://chestha.vercel.app/#/guide): Map of every page/section and every dashboard widget, with short plain-language descriptions.
- [About](https://chestha.vercel.app/#/about): Privacy notes, where data lives, maker links. Website-only (not hosted in the extension New Tab).
- [Changelog](https://chestha.vercel.app/#/changelog): Release notes with a version picker.
- [Workspace](https://chestha.vercel.app/#/dashboard): The live dashboard / New Tab workspace (widgets you arrange yourself).

## App sections (workspace)

- Tasks — today, upcoming, overdue, undated, completed.
- Calendar — date-only due dates; tasks are the single source of truth.
- DSA — curated packs + personal lists, revision ladder, daily targets.
- Grove — focus sessions that grow a garden and earn XP.
- Productive time — domain-only website time tracking (extension).
- Sounds — synthesised ambient mixes in the browser.
- Settings — theme, background, shortcuts, export/import, hide sections.
